title: File:045 Greater flamingos courtship display in the Camargue during mating season (slow motion) Video by Giles Laurent.webm
description: Greater flamingos courtship display in the Camargue during mating season, filmed in slow motion at a speed four times slower than reality. The slow motion footage enables to see in detail the rapid movements made by the greater flamingos during their courtship display.

title: File:043 Greater flamingo vocalizing in the Camargue during mating season (slow motion) Video by Giles Laurent.webm
description: Close-up of a greater flamingo vocalising in the Camargue during the mating season, filmed in slow motion at a speed four times slower than reality. The slow motion footage shows in detail the movements of the muscles that enable the flamingo to vocalise its call.

description: Greater flamingos courtship display in the Camargue during mating season (in normal speed)
